column1: # ZAP baseline rules (tab separated: rule id, action, comment). IGNORE hides the rule in ZAP's own summary; the gate
# (scripts/dast-check.mjs) fails on any alert of risk Medium or higher in the JSON report, whatever this file says, so an
# ignored rule can never hide a Medium or High finding. Every ignored rule needs a reason. Review when ZAP is upgraded.
